pages.text: "Grandpa, flowers on that boat!" Bung hopped to the edge. Grandpa's boat floated tied to a post. The flower boat was just one step away.
Bung wanted a flower for Ddori's ear. "Let us cross!" Little Ddori, a good pointer but not yet a talker, pointed at the flower boat.
Bung let go of Ddori's hand and reached a foot between the boats. Grandpa caught Bung's arm. "Wait!"
Just then, a big boat passed. Waves pushed in. The two boats slid apart, then together. Bung's heart thumped.
"Waves make boats dance." Grandpa pointed. Rock, rock, rock—waves passed one by one. "When all pass, the water calms."
Grandpa sat before Bung. "That is when you cross." Bung repeated, "When the waves pass, cross!" Ddori clapped. "Ah!"
All waves passed. The boats lay calm together. Grandpa lifted Ddori in one arm. "Now!" Bung held his hand tightly. One step, across!
On the flower boat, two white flowers went into Bung's hand. Bung drew Ddori's hand close and gave one. Both sniffed, shoulders rising.
Returning, Bung stopped first. "One, stop and look at both boats! Two, wait for all the waves! Three, hold Grandpa's hand to cross! When the waves pass, cross!"
Grandpa hugged each in an arm. "Even in a hurry, wait until the waves pass." Bung tucked a flower at Ddori's ear. "When the waves pass, cross!"
